Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.network.VirtualClient
org.adsl.server.network.socket.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, EndGameObserver, GameObserver, HomeObserver
public class SocketClientHandler extends VirtualClient implements Runnable
VirtualClient implementation for socket-connected clients.

Runs on its own thread (submitted to the server thread pool). Reads newline-delimited JSON from the socket input stream via JsonMessageHandler, deserialises each line into a ClientRequest, and dispatches it through VirtualClient.processRequest(ClientRequest). Responses are serialised back to JSON and written to the output stream. The thread exits when the connection is closed or an IOException occurs, triggering VirtualClient.handleDisconnection().
